```sql
WITH radnor_township AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Radnor Township'
    AND border_type = 'municipal'
    AND addr_state = 'Pennsylvania'
),
gardens AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM parks
  WHERE leisure = 'garden'
    AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM radnor_township)::geometry)
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(r.rast, (SELECT geometry FROM radnor_township)::geometry, TRUE) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geometry FROM radnor_township)::geometry)
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
),
average_slope AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_Stats(slope_raster.rast, 1, TRUE)).mean AS slope_mean
  FROM slope_raster
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(ST_Area(g.geometry)) / 1000000 FROM gardens g) AS total_garden_area_sqkm,
  (SELECT slope_mean FROM average_slope) AS average_slope_degrees;
```
